description: Write a robots.txt from this dataset for the kinds you allow or block. Each group cites the vendor page. effect request_only means the vendor does not say the crawler obeys that line. control_token is not training. The file has no User-agent: * group. This tool does not fetch any website. Do not send url, host, target, website, robots_url, or fetch.

allow.description: Kinds to Allow, such as search.

block.description: Kinds to Disallow, such as training.

path.description: Path the Allow or Disallow names. Defaults to /.

policy.description: Same choice in words, such as "allow search, block training".

name: suggest_robots
title: Write a cited robots.txt
